purpose: Research evidence only; not an enabled calculator profile.

geography.note: Six survey regions are not counties; validate county-to-region crosswalk before county selectors or estimates.

survey.name: Liberia 2024 Annual Agriculture Survey (LAAS-2024)
survey.coverage: National and regional sample estimates; Table 10 is national, not county-level.
survey.microdata: Anonymized public-use dataset catalogued; redistribution restricted; statistical/scientific use only.

production.scope: Table 10 gives national totals; no regional yield values should be inferred from crop participation shares.
quality: Do not recompute yield from printed aggregate area and quantity until LISGIS confirms estimator/denominator; rice output divided by harvested area does not equal printed yield.
Cassava estimate is timing-sensitive: only 28.3% reported harvesting; 87.5% of non-harvesters said it was not harvest season.
Report flags high-CV/low-precision estimates for sweet potato area/output, eggplant area/output, okra output, pepper planted area, and rubber planted/harvested area.

prices.source: World Bank Real Time Food Prices, Liberia
prices.limitation: Combines direct observations and machine-learning estimates; metadata include coverage/confidence and spatial interpolation. Not automatically farmgate prices; classify observation/model and price level.

costs.seed: Use/source shares available; current farmer-paid unit prices missing.
costs.fertilizer: About 7% use inorganic fertilizer and 17% organic manure; adoption shares are not prices, application rates or quantities.
costs.caveat: 2023/24 survey-period amounts, not current 2026 quotes. Sparse observations are withheld; low prevalence is not zero cost.

blockers: Reconcile Table 10 yield estimator/denominators with LISGIS; do not silently recompute.
Extract statistically valid crop area/output/yield by county or survey region; Table 10 is national.
Classify World Bank prices by commodity/date/market/currency and direct versus ML estimate; obtain true farmgate prices.
Obtain current farmer-paid seed, fertilizer, pesticide, irrigation, machinery, fuel, transport and labour quotations.
Build regional enterprise budgets and calculator regression tests.
next_step: Reconcile LAAS yield estimators with LISGIS; extract county/region crop tables; classify 27-market RTFP records; obtain current farmer-paid costs and build regional budgets.
decision: Liberia is not calculator-ready. Research refresh only; no activation, merge or deployment.
